findings.problem: The hint rules out wirklich but not echt, which is just as common and natural ('Der Film war echt gut'), and the '(very)' in the prompt also invites sehr, so the learner could give more than one right answer.
findings.fix: hint: before an adjective, as in really good; the word that also means right, not wirklich, echt or sehr

back.target: really, properly (intensifier before an adjective; literally right, correct)

note: The Spanish card realmente-really means truly or actually more than the intensifier, so leaving sameAs as null is reasonable.
